name: Shaw, Donnington and Snellsmore Circuit
notes: My regular weekend walk, taking in the pretty Lambourn River, historic Shaw House and Donnington Castle before looping through the lovely Snellsmore Common.

name: Inkpen and Walbury Hill Circuit
terrain: Village, woodland, arable fields in the South Wessex Downs
notes: Beautiful views across three counties from the highest point in the South East.

name: The Copses Circuit
terrain: Arable fields, woodland, and cannal towpath.
notes: A quick stroll in the outskirts of Newbury.

name: Ecchinswell and Ladle Hill Circuit
terrain: Village, woodland, arable fields in the South Wessex Downs
notes: Beautiful views and a well preserved Iron Age hillfort.

name: Ashmansworth and Faccombe Circuit
terrain: Village, woodland, arable fields in the South Wessex Downs
notes: A varied and surprisingly taxing walk in beautiful Hampshire countryside.

name: Beacon Hill and Old Burghclere Circuit
terrain: Village, woodland, arable fields and a disused railway in the South Wessex Downs
notes: Another stunning view from a well-preserved hillfort, followed by a nice circular walk through Old Burghclere.
